content.short: Magma Staking provides liquid staking on Monad, issuing a yield-bearing token against staked MON.
content.description: Magma is a liquid staking protocol on Monad where users stake MON into a pool and receive gMON to use in DeFi. Stakers earn base staking rewards plus additional APY from MEV: Monad validators bid in a Magma auction for blockspace, and the resulting revenue is shared back with stakers. Unstaking either waits around twelve hours or settles instantly by swapping through 0x, and its gVaults let a staker pick their own validator instead of accepting the pool default.
content.meta: Stake MON and keep a transferable token, one of the earlier liquid staking options on Monad.
